entities.title: Text-form fixtures

criteria: Each fixture parses, formats, or both, to its expected value or status and codes.

entities.title: Typed layer
entities.summary: At least one test per row of docs/library-api.md §2, outcomes, policies, the context, round trips and constructor checks.
criteria: Each type's total operations return values and its partial ones outcomes with the right codes (CivilDate, CivilYearMonth, CivilTime, CivilDateTime, FixedOffsetDateTime, ZonedIntent, Instant, the amounts, Interval).
Resolve answers gap, ambiguous, offset-mismatch, unknown-zone and outside-rule-window, and the policies choose as documented.
Outcome helpers never pick an answer silently; to_result is the JSON layer's envelope; TemporalContext.compare answers Multiple when the order depends on an overlap.
Policy forms take only CONSTRAIN; policies accept wire strings; a context needs ZoneRules.
parse(str(v)) and from_json(to_json(v)) give v back; values are hashable and immutable; JSON a typed value can't hold exactly is unsupported-operand.
Constructors reject impossible values with the right code, try_of returns outcomes, wrong Python types raise TypeError.
from_native and to_native follow the interop rules.

criteria: No module of src/utv, with strings and comments removed, calls now(), today(), time.time(), time_ns, astimezone() without an argument, localtime, fromtimestamp, utcnow or ZoneInfo(), imports locale, or reads environ.

entities.title: Native adapters
entities.summary: utv.native: the caller names the intent, a naive datetime is never local, lossy conversions back are refused or reported.
criteria: Dates and times convert directly; wrong types raise TypeError; an aware time is unsupported.
A naive datetime is floating, and never read as an instant, offset or zoned (local-zone).
A fixed timezone needs an intent (intent-required); an unknown tzinfo or intent is refused; a timedelta needs an intent.
A ZoneInfo datetime asserts the offset of its fold; a gap is not silently shifted; ZoneInfo("localtime") is refused.
Conversions back round-trip; years outside 1–9999 and sub-microsecond values are unsupported unless allow_loss, which reports precision-loss; a zoned value needs tz or reports zone-dropped.
An asserted offset picks the fold; without one an overlap is multiple and a gap none; the tz must be the same zone.

criteria: The leap rule holds for 2000, 2024, 0, −4, 1900 and 2026.
Real dates are valid and missing days, month 13 and day 0 invalid, also for month-day values and 21-digit years.
Other calendars and other kinds are unsupported; a structural error comes first.
